title: Nice everyday pan but food sticks to it even when oil is used and it requires a lot of elbow grease to clean
text: Nice everyday pan but food sticks to it even when oil is used and it requires a lot of elbow grease to clean. I purchased this at a Pampered Chef party. I love the look and design of this crock. It can be used on the stove, in the oven, etc. However, everything sticks to the pan (even if oil is used) and it's hard to clean. Had I known how it really performed in the kitchen I would have never purchased it. I do not feel it was worth the price I paid.
